glosses: Entrer dans quelque part pour faire une visite de surprise.
unvorhergesehen und ungebeten bei einem Ereignis oder einer Gruppe von Personen erscheinen

examples.text: Ich bin aus Versehen in die Party reingeplatzt.

glosses: To intrude; to enter or interrupt suddenly and without invitation.

examples.text: What makes you think you can just barge in and make demands of the CEO?
Don't barge in on us like that again; we are presently having a meeting.
According to a Fox News source speaking to the Daily Beast, Simmons barged in on a staff meeting, unbuttoned his shirt and exposed his torso, shouting: “Hey chicks, sue me!”
